messages:
Elaine (PM): Quick sync — we need a firm launch acceptance checklist for the Dedicated Predictor feature by EOD. Atlassian pilot has two hard asks: p95 latency <= 120ms and request error rate <= 0.5% over 1h under realistic customer load. Proposing: canary rollout (10% traffic), automated acceptance tests, and an automatic fallback to cached-model responses with a degraded schema when latency or errors spike. Thoughts?

Sam (Eng): Sounds reasonable. Question: fallback to cached-model => is that a full response or a summary hint? If we return a degraded schema we must version the response so clients can detect it. Also need to define exact signals to trigger fallback (e.g., rolling 5m p95 > 130ms OR 5m error rate > 0.7%).

Tariq (SRE): Agree we need explicit trigger thresholds. Suggest we use both absolute and relative triggers: absolute p95 > 120ms OR p95 increased by 40% vs baseline over 15m. For error budget, use 1h sliding window > 0.5% to trigger canary rollback + fallback. Also require an alert channel and runbook link in the PRD.

Ana (ProdOps): From launch ops POV, acceptance tests must be reproducible in CI. We should have a smoke suite that runs against canary endpoints: throughput ramp to 2x expected pilot qps, 30m soak, validate latency, errors, and a golden prompt set for functional correctness. Need a clear owner to run preflight.

Sam (Eng): Draft of smoke test script (local/CI) — run this against canary and prod-variant:```bash
# run 30m soak with increasing qps
python tests/soak_runner.py --endpoint $CANARY --qps 10:100 --duration 1800 --prompt-set tests/golden/prompts.json --capture-kv-cache-stats
# post-checks: p95, error_rate, token_cost
```We should also add a deterministic acceptance test for streaming aborts and prefix-heavy requests (long contexts).

Elaine (PM): Good. Let's make acceptance criteria explicit in PRD: 1) Functional: 95% of golden prompts match baseline intent with no regression >2% (we'll define metric). 2) SLO: p50/p95/p99 targets, but gating only on p95 and error_rate for launch. 3) Edge cases: streaming aborts recover with partial payload + consistent next-token behavior, long prefixes (>=8k tokens) must not increase tail latency > 2x baseline for same prompt length class.

Tariq (SRE): On measuring long prefixes, suggest we bucket by input token length (0-512, 513-2048, 2049-8192) and track separate SLOs for 99th in each bucket. For rollout, we can relax non-critical buckets but prod must meet primary bucket (0-2048) p95 <= 120ms.

Sam (Eng): Implementation note: fallback to cached-model will serve from a memory-backed KV store. Need schema for degraded response: "status":"degraded", "confidence_hint": <float>, and a short "explain" string. Clients must be able to parse it. Add a feature flag "predictor_degraded_payload_v1".

Ana (ProdOps): Can we add a mandatory canary ticket checklist before flip: test-run link, p95 table, error budget used, rollout % plan, rollback criteria, and contact oncall. I'll add a template in the PRD.

Sam (Eng): One more edge case — mixed-version routing: when we route to a quantized variant during heavy load, output distribution shifts slightly. We need an automatic regression detector that uses a small evaluation harness on live-sampled responses (1000 samples/hr) comparing embeddings similarity to baseline. If drift > threshold -> auto-fallback.

Elaine (PM): OK items to capture in PRD: explicit thresholds, canary checklist template, degraded payload schema + feature flag, acceptance smoke script (above), bucketed SLOs for long prefixes, live regression detector + sampling plan, runbooks and alert links. I'll assemble a PRD draft and ping owners. Owners: Sam for engineering runway, Tariq for SLO definitions/monitoring, Ana for rollout checklist and ops. Please ack and add any missing acceptance criteria. :thumbsup:

Sam (Eng): Ack. I'll add the smoke test PR and feature-flag RFC.

Tariq (SRE): Ack — I'll draft the SLO math and runbook.

Ana (ProdOps): Ack — will paste the checklist template into the PRD.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment 1799004425 for predictor-service/v2 started (10% traffic) :rocket:

Sam (Eng): Noted — running smoke locally against canary now and will link results in the PRD.

Elaine (PM): Thanks team — we'll aim to merge PRD by EOD and schedule a 15m sync tomorrow morning if any open disputes.
